name: Alkosign Ltd.
summary: Alkosign Ltd. is dedicated to producing visual communication systems. Its broad array of offerings features various writing and display boards, including vertical and horizontal sliding models and glass writing boards, alongside chalks, stands, and essential accessories. The company further provides school benches and desks, keyboards, first aid boxes, and letter boxes. Established on March 20, 2020, this firm maintains its headquarters in Thane, India.
